description: University rankings side by side from ShanghaiRanking ARWU (rank, national rank, total and six indicator scores) and Times Higher Education World University Rankings (rank, overall, teaching, research, citations, industry and international scores, students, student/staff ratio, % international, female:male). Give university and/or country (at least one); arwuYear and theYear pick the editions (default 2026). Use it to compare institutions across both rankings in one call; for ARWU alone use search_shanghai_arwu_rankings, for subject rankings search_shanghai_gras_rankings, for bibliometric indicators search_leiden_ranking. No match in either ranking returns 404 and is not charged. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Country as the rankings write it, e.g. United Kingdom, China, Turkey/Türkiye

university.description: Part of a university name, e.g. Oxford, Tsinghua, Bogazici

title: University rankings side by side from ShanghaiRanking ARWU
